She wears the supplied black sleeveless fitted outfit with a deep V neckline and short skirt, sheer black stockings, black heels, gold bangles and black gloves.

Simple gray studio backdrop with no distractions and natural contact shadow.
Preserve supplied outfit, gloves, bangles, face, hair, expression, and quiet glamour direction.
